title: Lovable: from a side project to a $13.3 billion AI company
disclosure: AFFILIATE LINK IN DESCRIPTION - AI VOICE

scenes.label: DEAL ROOM
scenes.narration: August 2026. A software company from Stockholm is now valued at 13.3 billion dollars. Three years earlier, it was one man's side project on GitHub.

title: FROM SIDE PROJECT
TO $13 BILLION
scenes.subtitle: THE LOVABLE STORY
scenes.narration: This is the story of Lovable, the tool that builds apps when you chat with AI.

scenes.label: HOME DESK
scenes.narration: June 2023. Anton Osika, a Swedish engineer, puts a free, open-source tool on GitHub. He calls it GPT Engineer.

scenes.label: GITHUB
scenes.narration: You describe an app in plain words, and the AI writes the code. Developers love it. It collects tens of thousands of stars.

scenes.label: STOCKHOLM
scenes.narration: Osika teams up with engineer Fabian Hedin. In Stockholm, they turn the side project into a company, with a paid product called GPT Engineer App.

scenes.label: ENGINEERING
scenes.narration: But there is a problem. The tool still feels made for programmers, and most people who want an app cannot code.

scenes.label: BIG DECISION
scenes.narration: So they make a risky choice. They rebuild the product for people who have never written code, and they drop the old name.

scenes.label: LAUNCH DAY
scenes.narration: November 2024. The new product launches as Lovable. Reports say it reached number one on Product Hunt and Hacker News that day.
But fast growth has a dark side. In March 2025, a security researcher reports that many apps built with Lovable could leave user data exposed.

scenes.label: SECURITY TEAM
scenes.narration: The issue gets an official security code. Lovable disputes it, saying each app owner must protect their own data, but it also ships a security scanner.

scenes.label: SERVER ROOM
scenes.narration: Then the numbers go wild. In July 2025, about eight months after launch, Lovable says it hits 100 million dollars in yearly recurring revenue.

scenes.label: OPEN OFFICE
scenes.narration: The team keeps hiring, and the promise stays simple. Describe what you want, watch it appear, then change it by chatting.

scenes.label: SERIES B
scenes.narration: December 2025. Investors put 330 million dollars into Lovable, at a valuation of 6.6 billion dollars.
By early 2026, reports put its yearly revenue run rate around 400 million dollars. The company says it added 100 million in one month, with just 146 employees.

scenes.label: SERIES C
scenes.narration: Then August 2026. A 400 million dollar round, led by Menlo Ventures, values Lovable at 13.3 billion. That is double, in about eight months.
Today Lovable is one of Europe's biggest AI success stories, and it is still based in Stockholm, not Silicon Valley.

scenes.label: YOUR TURN
scenes.caption: TRY IT FREE
scenes.narration: So how can you use it? The free plan gives you a few credits every day. Type an idea, like a booking page, and watch it build a first version.

scenes.label: YOUR APP
scenes.narration: Then ask for changes in plain English. When you need more, paid plans add more credits. Check the pricing page first, because it changes often.
